title: Early Learning Contact
before:
Lee Anne Larsen
Director of Early Learning

Supports the following areas:

  • Questions about statewide early learning policy or programs.
  • Information or support related to public pre-K.
  • Guidance on early elementary instruction, assessment, or professional learning, including the Maine DOE’s For ME Instructional Programming.
  • Statewide early learning initiatives and priorities.

Phone: 207-446-3629

Email: LeeAnn.Larsen@maine.gov

Nicole Madore
Early Childhood Specialist

Supports the following areas:

  • Chapter 124: Basic Approval Standards for Public Preschool Programs—including program considerations, locations, partnerships, and data.
  • Support and resources related to early learning and development standards and high-quality curriculum and assessment tools and practices for pre-K–grade 2.
  • For ME Instructional Programming questions, training, and support.

Phone: 207-446-3967

Email: Nicole.Madore@maine.gov

Stacie McCoy
Head Start Collaboration Director

Supports the following areas:

  • Questions about Head Start, including connections with local Head Start grantees, locations, and data.
  • Updates or connections to Head Start resources and priorities.
  • Opportunities for collaboration and partnership related to Head Start and other services and initiatives that support Maine’s most vulnerable children and families.

Phone: 207-816-2334

Email: Stacie.McCoy@maine.gov

Marcy Whitcomb
Public Pre-K Consultant

Supports the following areas:

  • Technical assistance for public pre-K and partnership programs and classrooms.
  • Professional development for early childhood educators, including Pre-K for ME and best practice in early childhood classrooms.
  • Questions and support focused on system building to support transitions to kindergarten.
  • Support and guidance with alignment to Chapter 124: Basic Approval Standards for Public Preschool Programs.

Phone: 207-441-2561

Email: Marcy.R.Whitcomb@maine.gov

Eartha Zahler
Pre-K Expansion Contract Grant Specialist

Supports the following areas:

  • Support for Maine Jobs and Recovery Plan Pre-K Expansion Grant school administrative unit invoice processing.
  • Support in understanding or amending Pre-K Expansion Grant contracts.
  • Questions regarding the overall parameters and reach of the Pre-K Expansion Grants, especially from involved school administrative unit grantees.

Phone: 207-624-6669

Email: Eartha.Zahler@maine.gov

Sue Gallant
First 10 Community School Specialist

Supports the following areas:

  • The First 10 Community School Pilot.
  • Exploration of prenatal to third grade (PN-3rd) models that support school readiness.
  • Questions regarding the use of “The Basics” parenting strategies in Maine.
  • Information on community collaborations that support early learning.

Phone: 207-215-6341

Email: Sue.Gallant@maine.gov

Michelle Belanger
Pre-K Partnership Specialist

Supports the following areas:

  • Questions about public pre-K partnerships for both school administrative units and community partners.
  • Exploration of opportunities for partnering for public pre-K.
  • Professional development for educators related to public pre-K.

Phone: 207-530-7826

Email: Michelle.Belanger@maine.gov

Renee Reilly
Preschool Development Grant Manager

Supports the following areas:

  • Support for submitting an invoice for a Preschool Development Grant-funded project.
  • Support on a contract funded by the Preschool Development Grant.
  • Information about For ME Instructional Programming professional learning opportunities.
  • Information about the Kindergarten Entry Inventory (KEI) pilot project.
  • Information about Emergent Literacy and Maine Youth Thriving professional learning opportunities.

Phone: 207-816-0572

Email: Renee.A.Reilly@maine.gov

notes: 468 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 2 addresses are shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Marcy.R.Whitcomb@maine.gov → Marcy.r.Whitcomb@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 8 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
